selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a coherent multi-hop sequence. The player must first locate a redstone_block, which serves as a landmark/marker indicating the location of the light_gray_terracotta deposit nearby. Once the redstone_block is found, the player knows where to mine the light_gray_terracotta. This creates a natural dependency: the redstone_block acts as a visual beacon that guides the player to the terracotta mining site. Both tasks are observable (finding a distinct red block, then mining a specific colored terracotta), verifiable, and don't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — just navigation and block-breaking skills.

edges.reason: The redstone_block serves as a landmark beacon; light_gray_terracotta is placed adjacent to it, so finding the redstone_block first guides the player to the terracotta location

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The redstone block pillar base is at spawn-relative (8, 2, 8). max_distance=5 ensures the player must walk from spawn (~11.5 blocks away) to within 5 blocks of the pillar, preventing trivial pre-satisfaction from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 degrees ensures the player is actually looking at the pillar, modeling 'the player has found and is observing the redstone block'.

Uses inventory_has because mining light_gray_terracotta with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no light_gray_terracotta in inventory (only a wooden_pickaxe), so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

scene_description: A flat grass plain with a prominent redstone block pillar (4 blocks tall) rising from a stepped light_gray_terracotta mound. The terracotta forms a 3-tier pyramid: 6x6 base at ground level (y=-1), 4x4 middle layer (y=0), 2x2 top layer (y=1), with the redstone pillar (y=2 through y=5) on top. Player spawns ~11 blocks away with a wooden pickaxe. The redstone pillar serves as a visual beacon guiding the player to the terracotta deposit.
task_text: Find the tall red redstone block pillar in the distance, walk to it, then mine one of the light gray terracotta blocks at its base using your pickaxe.
design_notes: The redstone pillar at (8, 2-5, 8) spawn-relative is bright red and 4 blocks tall, making it easily visible from spawn. The terracotta mound (6x6 base, 4x4 mid, 2x2 top) provides ample mineable blocks. The wooden pickaxe is sufficient to mine terracotta (hardness 1.25, no mining level requirement). The scene is compact (~11 blocks from spawn to target) and fully navigable on flat terrain. No obstacles between spawn and target.
